name: Simple Heightmap Voxel Generation
definition: A method to generate a voxel terrain mesh by iterating over a 2D grid of chunks and vertices, calculating a height based on sine and cosine functions, and outputting triangle vertices for each unit square.
summary: Simple Heightmap Voxel Generation creates smooth, deterministic 2D terrain meshes in 3D space using sine and cosine functions, avoiding the stochastic noise of random heightmaps.
